title: citydiff tour, version 1
description: An ordered script of steps over the citydiff scene of one commit range. Names are resolved against that scene by `citydiff tour validate`.

range.description: The base..head the tour was written for, as passed to -range.

name.description: A node name: a package path (barse/db, db), a declaration (generator.NewGenerator, Generator.Run, barse/db.Queries.ListDecks), a Rust item (crate::mod::f, <T as Trait>::m), or a scene id. A tail of whole segments is enough when it is unique.

note.description: Markdown shown in the note panel: paragraphs, **bold**, *italic*, `code`, fenced code, lists, headings and http(s) links.

duration.description: Seconds the step plays before autoplay moves on.

mode.description: changes colours the diff and draws the dependency arcs; full is the plain city.

select.description: A package or external import to select and fly to. Its dependency or changed-call arcs are drawn.

focus.description: A node to focus. A function or method opens its call focus, a type or variable is selected, a package is selected.

highlight.description: Nodes to light up together. Calls between them are drawn as arcs.

path.description: Light the shortest resolved call path between two functions or methods, with its arcs.

dim.description: With highlight or path, shade everything else. false keeps the rest of the city bright.

camera.description: overview frames the city, top looks straight down, fit frames the step's nodes, close moves in on them. Defaults to the camera of select/focus, else fit when there are nodes, else overview.

zoom.description: Multiplies the camera's distance after the camera move; 0.5 is twice as close.

code.description: A declaration whose source is shown under the note, as a diff when it changed.
